summary: Main-menu transition/restore handler. Enters the session critical section and makes a system OS API call on the session data object unk_7CE24C, then conditionally dispatches the Main Menu scene lookup when ConditionalFlagReturn reports true. If the object header reached from this has its byte activation flag at +0x14 set and the dword at +0x20 equals 1, restores previously saved global values from obj+0x50 and obj+0x54 (the latter clamped into a range bounded by two globals), resets a flag, runs a zero-guarded division, and conditionally resets virtual dispatch state.

local_names.this: object whose pointed-to header drives the restore path
local_names.v1: dword read from obj+0x54, range-clamped before being stored to dword_7D0410
local_names.v3: pointer read from this+0x0, the target object header

operations.description: Enter the session critical section: sub_4A0250(&unk_7CE24C) acquires the lock on the session data object.
SystemOSAPICall(&unk_7CE24C) invokes the system OS API with the session data object.
Proceeds to the menu dispatch only when ConditionalFlagReturn(this) returns non-zero.
LookupDispatch(aMainMenu, -1) dispatches the 'Main Menu' scene lookup with key -1.
v3 = *(this): dereference the object pointer stored at this+0x0 into v3.
Run the restore path only when the byte activation flag at obj+0x14 is non-zero AND the dword at obj+0x20 equals 1 (guard:0).
dword_7D2E44 = v3[20]: restore the saved value read from obj+0x50 into global dword_7D2E44.
v1 = v3[21]; dword_7D0410 = v1: copy the saved value read from obj+0x54 into global dword_7D0410.
Clamp dword_7D0410 into the range bounded below by dword_7D0418 and above by dword_7D041C.
byte_5EA53E = 0: reset the scoring gate flag to zero.
SafeDivisionWithZeroGuard(0.1): run a division guarded against zero division using the literal 0.1.
When flt_7CF380 is greater than 0.0, reset the virtual dispatch state at byte_8AC494.
VirtualDispatchStateReset(&byte_8AC494) resets the virtual dispatch state buffer.
Reached from SessionMenuModeSwitch and RestartGate as part of the menu/restart transition path.
